title: NOBODY DID IT
subtitle: ODYSSEUS vs. THE CYCLOPS
beats:
THE WORST AIRBNB
IN ANCIENT GREECE
Odysseus found the worst Airbnb in Greek mythology.

ONE GIANT.
ZERO EXITS.
The Cyclops trapped his crew inside. Then asked his name.

MY NAME?
NOBODY.
Nobody, said Odysseus. Great username. Terrible search result.

NOBODY
IS HURTING ME!
They blinded the giant while he slept. He yelled: Nobody is hurting me!

SUPPORT TICKET:
CLOSED.
His neighbours heard that and left. Customer support: ticket closed.

SHEEP: THE ORIGINAL
GETAWAY VEHICLE
The crew escaped under his sheep. The plan actually worked.

HE TOLD HIM
HIS REAL NAME.
Then Odysseus shouted his real name. The giant called his dad: Poseidon.

STEALTH: 10/10
EXIT INTERVIEW: 0/10
Stealth: ten out of ten. Exit interview: zero.

title: FLIGHT MODE
subtitle: ICARUS IGNORES THE TUTORIAL
beats:
HE SKIPPED
THE FLIGHT TUTORIAL.
Icarus got wings. Immediately skipped the tutorial.

FEATHERS + WAX
WHAT COULD GO WRONG?
His dad, Daedalus, built wings from feathers and wax to escape Crete.

DAD: STAY
IN THE MIDDLE.
The rule was simple: not too low, not too close to the sun.

ICARUS:
BUT THE VIEW THOUGH
Icarus loved flying. So he climbed. And climbed. And climbed.

WAX INTEGRITY:
1%
The sun softened the wax. His feathers started coming loose.

FLIGHT MODE
DISCONNECTED
No feathers. No lift. Icarus fell into the sea.

THE WARNING
WASN'T A SUGGESTION.
Daedalus lost his son. The Icarian Sea remembers his name.

ANCIENT GREECE:
NO RESPAWN BUTTON
Ancient Greece had no respawn button. Read the tutorial.

title: ALMOST THERE
subtitle: SISYPHUS vs. THE PROGRESS BAR
beats:
YOUR DOWNLOAD
HAS REACHED 99%
Your download hits ninety-nine percent. Meet Sisyphus.

ONE ROCK.
ONE VERY LONG SHIFT.
His punishment: push a massive stone up a hill. Forever.

PROGRESS:
47%
He leans in. Every muscle working. The summit gets closer.

PROGRESS:
99%
One last push. This is it. Surely this is it.
CONNECTION LOST.
Nope. The stone rolls all the way back down.

AUTOSAVE:
NEVER HEARD OF IT
No checkpoint. No autosave. Just him, the hill, and the rock.

RETRY?
RETRY.
So he walks back down. Puts his hands on it. Starts again.

GREEK MYTHOLOGY
INVENTED THE GRIND
Greek mythology invented the grind. Unfortunately, the rewards are terrible.
